high_level_description: The image shows a close-up view of a wooden shelf containing various pairs of sandals. The focus is on two pairs of sandals placed side by side in the center of the frame. Foreground (Center): Two pairs of brown sandals are prominently displayed. The pair on the left has multiple straps crisscrossing over the foot, with a thick sole that appears to be made of rubber or a similar material. The pair on the right has a simpler design with fewer straps and a single buckle at the ankle strap. The sole is also thick and seems to be made of rubber.
